    arc = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(seg)]
    total = arc[-1]
    count = max(2, int(math.ceil(total / spacing_m)) + 1)
    samples = np.linspace(0, total, count)

    press = start_press_mm + (end_press_mm - start_press_mm) * samples / max(total, 1e-9)
    return [pose(xi, yi, PAPER_Z - pi/1000.0, quat) for xi, yi, pi in zip(x, y, press)]


def execute_stroke(r, name, raster, start_press_mm, end_press_mm, last_cmd, quat, run_dir):
    """High transit, one continuous pressed path, and a clear lift."""
    xy = raster_to_world(raster[0])
    approach = pose(xy[0], xy[1], 0.060, quat)  # 40 mm above paper
    contact = pose(xy[0], xy[1], PAPER_Z - start_press_mm / 1000.0, quat)
    q = []
    q += interpolate(last_cmd, approach, 0.010)
    q += interpolate(approach, contact, 0.003)
    q += raster_path(raster, quat, start_press_mm, end_press_mm)
    end_xy = raster_to_world(raster[-1])
    end_contact = pose(end_xy[0], end_xy[1], PAPER_Z - end_press_mm / 1000.0, quat)
    q += interpolate(end_contact, pose(end_xy[0], end_xy[1], 0.060, quat), 0.004)

                   video='both', video_fps=5, note='clear main sheet for inspection')
